itemListElement.name: Granola vs Otter AI in 2026: Which Suits US Teams?

mainEntity.name: Is Granola better than Otter AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Granola is better for private, bot-free notes and has no minute caps. Otter is better for live transcripts, automatic recording and CRM integrations. The better tool depends on whether you want notes or a full record.
Yes, Otter remains a strong transcription tool with live captions, speaker identification and integrations. Its main drawbacks are the 30-minute cap on free conversations and the visible bot.
Granola transcribes your meeting audio to write notes, but it does not show a live transcript on screen the way Otter does. Its output is structured notes rather than a word-for-word transcript view.

mainEntity.name: How much does Otter AI cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Otter Pro costs $16.99 a month on monthly billing or $8.33 a month billed yearly. Business costs $30 a month or $19.99 billed yearly. The Basic plan is free with 300 minutes a month.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Granola and Otter together?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can, but it is rarely worth paying for both. Running 2 note takers doubles the notes to review and may confuse attendees. Pick the one that matches how you work.

mainEntity.name: Which is better for Microsoft Teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Otter's agent joins Microsoft Teams meetings directly.
